name: cobblers

rejected_artifacts.reason: sawtooth wraparound across the surface; 7.3% of horizontally adjacent pixels differ by >100; stored as 8-bit RGB with height only in the red channel
landmass clipped to 255 (mean 244, median 255); no land elevation data

notes: origin_x/origin_z are null until the northwest corner is confirmed from in-game F3. The validator fails while they are unset.
bounds are derived from grid origin + cell_size * columns/rows and are not authored by hand.
import values are expressed in the 8-bit input units of the rejected export (input_range 0-255). They must be restated against the 16-bit re-export before any import is run.
source_root is machine-specific and is not committed. Set COBBLERS_SOURCE_ROOT or pass --source-root.
